items.title: Purple development moves to the WooCommerce monorepo
items.zh_title: Purple 主题开发并入 WooCommerce 主仓库
items.zh_oneliner: 该主题仍独立维护，但开发协作统一进了主仓库。
items.en_oneliner: The theme is still maintained separately, but development now happens in the main monorepo.

items.title: Shopify, Vercel Arm Stores for AI Agents
items.zh_title: Shopify 与 Vercel 联手让店铺为 AI 智能体做好准备
items.zh_oneliner: 店铺要能被 AI 智能体顺利访问与下单，基建要先到位。
items.en_oneliner: Stores must be easy for AI agents to browse and buy from, so the infrastructure has to come first.

items.title: How SMBs Can Keep AI Website Agents Under Control
items.zh_title: 中小企业如何管住 AI 网站智能体
items.zh_oneliner: AI 智能体访问网站要设边界，别让它乱跑。
items.en_oneliner: AI agents visiting a website need boundaries so they do not run wild.
